description: This file defines the base class for tree nodes in a tree view widget, including properties, initialization, rendering, and dynamic loading functionalities.

classes.name: YAHOO.widget.Node
classes.description: A class representing a node in a tree view, with methods for rendering, toggling, and managing child nodes.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the node with data, parent, and expanded state, and registers it with the tree.

methods.name: appendChild
methods.description: Adds a child node to this node's children collection.

methods.name: getSiblings
methods.description: Returns an array of sibling nodes.

methods.name: showChildren
methods.description: Displays this node's children.

methods.name: hideChildren
methods.description: Hides this node's children.

methods.name: getElId
methods.description: Returns the DOM element ID for this node's container.

methods.name: getChildrenElId
methods.description: Returns the DOM element ID for this node's children container.

methods.name: getToggleElId
methods.description: Returns the DOM element ID for this node's toggle icon.

methods.name: getEl
methods.description: Returns the DOM element for this node.

methods.name: getChildrenEl
methods.description: Returns the DOM element for this node's children container.

methods.name: getToggleEl
methods.description: Returns the DOM element for this node's toggle icon.

methods.name: getToggleLink
methods.description: Generates the JavaScript link to toggle this node.

methods.name: collapse
methods.description: Collapses this node, hiding its children.

methods.name: expand
methods.description: Expands this node, showing its children.

methods.name: getStyle
methods.description: Returns the CSS class name for the toggle icon based on node state.

methods.name: getHoverStyle
methods.description: Returns the CSS class name for hover state of the toggle icon.

methods.name: expandAll
methods.description: Recursively expands all child nodes.

methods.name: collapseAll
methods.description: Recursively collapses all child nodes.

methods.name: setDynamicLoad
methods.description: Configures the node for dynamic loading of children.

methods.name: isRoot
methods.description: Checks if this node is the root node.

methods.name: isDynamic
methods.description: Determines if this node's children are loaded dynamically.

methods.name: hasChildren
methods.description: Checks if this node has children or might have children if lazy-loaded.

methods.name: toggle
methods.description: Toggles between expanded and collapsed states.

methods.name: getHtml
methods.description: Returns the HTML markup for this node and its children.

methods.name: getChildrenHtml
methods.description: Returns the HTML for the children container.

methods.name: renderChildren
methods.description: Generates the HTML for child nodes, handling dynamic loading if necessary.

methods.name: completeRender
methods.description: Renders all child nodes after data is loaded.

methods.name: loadComplete
methods.description: Callback after dynamic child data is loaded, updates DOM and expands node.

methods.name: getAncestor
methods.description: Returns ancestor node at specified depth.

methods.name: getDepthStyle
methods.description: Returns CSS class for spacer at specified depth.

methods.name: getNodeHtml
methods.description: Placeholder for node-specific HTML, meant to be overridden.
